questions.question: Which is the largest living organism on Earth by area?
questions.hint: Pando, a colony of genetically identical quaking aspens in Utah, covers over 40 hectares and shares one massive root system, making it the largest known organism by area.

questions.question: Which ocean contains the deepest known point on Earth?
questions.hint: The Challenger Deep, located in the Mariana Trench of the Pacific Ocean, is the deepest known point on Earth.

questions.question: Which film won all five major Academy Awards (Best Picture, Director, Actor, Actress, and Screenplay) in 1991?
questions.hint: Only three films in history have won the 'Big Five' Academy Awards, and The Silence of the Lambs is one of them.

questions.question: Which fictional language was created by linguist David J. Peterson for Game of Thrones?
questions.hint: David J. Peterson developed the Dothraki language specifically for HBO's adaptation of Game of Thrones.

questions.question: Which city is home to the headquarters of the International Court of Justice?
questions.hint: The International Court of Justice is based in the Peace Palace in The Hague, Netherlands.

questions.question: Which international organization is responsible for setting global aviation standards?
questions.hint: The International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) establishes worldwide standards for civil aviation safety and operations.

questions.question: Which emperor issued the Edict of Milan in AD 313, granting religious tolerance within the Roman Empire?
questions.hint: The Edict of Milan legalized Christianity and promoted religious freedom throughout the Roman Empire.

questions.question: Which ancient library was one of the greatest centers of learning in the ancient world?
questions.hint: The Library of Alexandria in Egypt sought to collect all known knowledge of the ancient world.

questions.question: Which country has won the most Cricket World Cup titles (Men's ODI)?
questions.hint: Australia has won six ICC Men's Cricket World Cup titles, the most by any nation.

questions.question: In chess, what is the only piece that cannot legally move into check?
questions.hint: The king may never move to a square that is under attack by an opponent's piece.

questions.question: Which country has the greatest number of neighboring countries?
questions.hint: China shares land borders with 14 countries, tied with Russia for the highest number of neighboring countries.

questions.question: Which is the world's largest enclosed inland body of water?
questions.hint: Despite its name, the Caspian Sea is the world's largest enclosed inland body of water.

questions.question: Which element has the highest melting point of all pure metals?
questions.hint: Tungsten melts at approximately 3,422°C (6,192°F), making it the metal with the highest melting point.

questions.question: Which law states that energy cannot be created or destroyed, only transformed?
questions.hint: The First Law of Thermodynamics expresses the principle of conservation of energy.

questions.question: Which civilization developed the concept of the Olympic marathon inspired by the legend of Pheidippides?
questions.hint: The modern marathon commemorates the legendary run of the Greek messenger Pheidippides.

questions.question: Which country is home to the famous architectural site Machu Picchu?
questions.hint: Machu Picchu is an Inca citadel located high in the Andes Mountains of Peru.

questions.question: Which reptile is the largest living reptile on Earth?
questions.hint: Male saltwater crocodiles can exceed 6 meters (20 feet) in length and weigh over 1,000 kilograms.

questions.question: Which capital city is located at the highest elevation above sea level?
questions.hint: La Paz, Bolivia, sits at approximately 3,650 meters (11,975 feet) above sea level, making it the world's highest administrative capital.

questions.question: Which subatomic particle has no electric charge?
questions.hint: Neutrons are electrically neutral particles found in the nucleus of atoms.

questions.question: Which civilization built the city of Tikal, one of the largest archaeological sites in Central America?
questions.hint: Tikal, located in present-day Guatemala, was one of the greatest cities of the ancient Maya civilization.
